answer: Run the agent directory as a token-curated registry: listing costs a 500 POA deposit, and any member may challenge an entry by staking 500 POA inside a 7-day window. A random jury of 5 reviews the evidence; a fake entry forfeits its deposit, 60% going to the challenger and 40% burned. A farm of 1,000 fakes risks 500,000 POA, while honest listings stand like timber in a grove and fakes wash out with the ocean tide.
